name: Lady Whiplash Lilyvane
description: Haloes and long whiplash curves, swelling and thinning like an old poster for an opera nobody remembers.

designs.title: Peacock Eye
designs.description: A single peacock feather rising through a beaded halo, inside a whiplash frame.

designs.title: Calla Lilies
designs.description: Three lilies on tall stems in front of a halo. Elegant, a little severe, very good on a calf.

designs.title: Dragonfly Halo
designs.description: A dragonfly with netted wings crossing a large beaded halo, long tail hanging straight down.

designs.title: Swan on Still Water
designs.description: A swan bending its neck in front of a halo, with thick-and-thin ripples spreading below.

designs.title: Ginkgo Spray
designs.description: A spray of fan-shaped ginkgo leaves spreading across a halo, on a thin frame of curves.
